sentences.text:
Birbal Sahish vs Unknown on 25 February, 2026
25.02.2026
Item no. 15.
Court No.8.
 Ab
 Cra (Db) 387 of 2025

In the matter of : Birbal Sahish  ......Appellant.
 Mr. Mit Guha Roy,
 Ms. Sneha Saha .......for the Appellant.
 Dictated by Arijit Banerjee, J.
1.
Pursuant to our order dated February 18, 2026, learned lawyer has been engaged by the High Court Legal Services Committee to represent the appellant.
The conviction was under Sections 498A/302 IPC in the year 2013.

2. On the request of learned advocate for the appellant, we direct the Superintendent of the Medinipur Central Correctional Home to extend all cooperation to learned advocate for the appellant to enable him to hold a video conference with the convict and also to interact with the next of kins of the convict so that he is able to properly prepare himself in the matter.
3. Let this matter be listed again on 25.03.2026 under the same heading.
On that date, it is expected that learned lawyer for the appellant will file a formal Memorandum of Appeal.

(Apurba Sinha Ray, J.) (Arijit Banerjee, J.)
